## Services Offered
We provide comprehensive handyman and remodeling services throughout St. George and surrounding communities:

1. Handyman Services — Small repairs, odd jobs, punch lists, fixture installations, door adjustments
2. Home Remodeling — Kitchen and bathroom updates, decks, outdoor living spaces, whole-room renovations
3. Drywall Repair — Hole patching, crack repair, texture matching, water damage restoration
4. Door Installation — Interior and exterior door installation and replacement, hardware, weather sealing
5. Caulking & Weatherproofing — Window and door sealing, exterior trim caulking, energy efficiency improvements
6. Interior Painting — Walls, trim, ceilings, single rooms or full interiors
7. Basic Plumbing & Fixture Installation — Faucets, sinks, toilets, basic plumbing repairs
8. Home Maintenance & Repairs — Ongoing maintenance work, seasonal repairs, preventive care

## Common Questions Answered

Q: How quickly can you start work?
A: Call or send the form and Tony will get back to you with the first available time; urgent problems are fitted in as quickly as the schedule allows.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. We provide free, detailed estimates with no obligation. We explain the scope, timeline, and costs upfront before any work begins.

Q: What types of projects do you handle?
A: Everything from small repairs (drywall, painting, fixtures) to major projects (kitchen/bath remodels, decks, whole-room renovations).

## Business Practices
- Free on-site estimates for all projects

- Owner-operated with direct accountability
- Careful prep and masking on interior painting projects

## Geographic Context
St. George, Utah is located in southwestern Utah's Washington County, part of the Mojave Desert region. The climate is hot and dry with extreme summer heat, which makes weatherproofing, caulking, and exterior maintenance critical for local homes. Common local home issues include UV damage to exterior surfaces, thermal expansion/contraction causing cracks, and dust infiltration requiring regular sealing.
